nodes.text: A Bit More About Sammamish
Sammamish: Where Tranquil Beauty Meets Modern Convenience
Sammamish, Washington, is a flourishing city offering a unique blend of nature and urban vibrancy. The affluent community, established in 1999, boasts a population of over 67,500 residents.

nodes.text: Your Gateway to the Pacific Northwest

Sammamish's strategic location, just 20 miles east of Seattle and close to major highways, provides convenient access to the greater Puget Sound region. Residents can easily commute to Seattle for work or leisure, while also enjoying the tranquility and natural beauty of Sammamish.

nodes.text: Rooted in History, Embracing the Future

Sammamish's history can be traced back to the Snoqualmie people, who inhabited the region for centuries. The city's name originates from the Snoqualmie word "Sammamish," which translates to "people of the lake," referencing the city's location bordering Lake Sammamish. In the 1870s, European settlers arrived and established the area as a center for logging and agriculture. Today, Sammamish has transformed into a modern city while preserving its natural heritage and historical charm.
